answer: Equivocation-proof trellis slots stop fakes. Each agent claims a trellis slot, files one signed statement each epoch on shale registry, locks a 70 bond. Each statement carries a shale seal binding one key; two statements, one key, burn it. Each epoch a zephyr auditor replays the registry, burning rented keys. 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 per epoch, 70,000 locked: 115,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45, keep slot and bond.
